admission.justification: The launch regression protects the caller from losing the missing filename behind a longer piece of provider advice.

applicability: A role start that warns about missing requirement copies.
conditions: The launch receipt builds the missing-copy notice before appending step-up advice.
Later producers append their notices to the receipt warning.
The shared guard fits a measured warning prefix into the remaining space.
exclusions: Role starts with no missing requirement copies.
An unusually long list of filenames can extend beyond the retained prefix.
statement: The role start places its missing requirement filenames ahead of its other notices so the warning prefix keeps the names that fit.
